Realm of Aetheria

Choose your path, hero. The overworld awaits — four dungeons call beyond the trees.

Warrior

Master of blade and shield. High damage, high defense. Parries like a dream.

STR 15 · DEX 5 · VIT 15 · INT 2

Rogue

Fast, deadly, hard to hit. Strikes from the shadows and vanishes before you can react.

Mage

Wields raw arcane power. Ranged spells that grow devastating with level.

STR 2 · DEX 5 · VIT 8 · INT 20

Controls

WASD / ArrowsMove
Left MouseAttack
Right MouseMove to point
Drag / Q, ERotate camera
Hold ShiftBlock (50% reduction). Release within 0.3s of a hit to PARRY
SpaceRoll (i-frames, 1.5s cooldown)
1 – 4Class skills
5 / 6Health / Mana potion
FInteract (merchant, healer)
I / C / HInventory / Character / Help
EscClose panels

Tips

• Parry (block just before impact) stuns the attacker and empowers your next strike.
• Elites (glowing, larger) always drop gear.
• The healer fountain in town restores you fully.
• Spend attribute points with C, skill points on class skills.
